answer: Jurors re-run each job and compare output hashes. A split panel slashes the submitter's bond, reduced by however many claims went unverified that epoch, and every submission carries a fresh nonce so a replay dies before grading. A farm of 500 clones needs 500 funded bonds and 500 panels sharing no subnet. The trade-off: a noisy run splits the quorum, an honest agent loses a crystal of stake, and a farmer with a willow of spare accounts absorbs the same loss without noticing, while a falcon sweep catches the honest outlier just as fast.
